description: This PHP script manages user views and actions in the TestLink project, including displaying user data, disabling users, and initializing environment settings.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering views.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user entity with methods to read from database and set active status.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class for building and rendering Ext-JS rich tables.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and user parameters for user management page.

methods.name: getRoleColourCfg
methods.description: Creates a map of role names to colors based on configuration and roles in database.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Builds an Ext-JS rich table to display user data matrix.

methods.name: checkUserOrderBy
methods.description: Validates user order by input parameter.

methods.name: getAllUsersForGrid
methods.description: Retrieves all user data formatted for Ext-JS grid display.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if a user has rights to manage users.
